fields.description: day when the insured completely stopped working due to the disability.

fields.description: year when the insured completely stopped working due to the disability.

fields.name: work_return_status
fields.description: Indicates whether the insured has returned to work, part-time, full-time, or has not returned.

fields.description: Name of the first physician or medical practitioner consulted.

fields.description: Address of the first physician or medical practitioner consulted.

fields.description: Date of consultation with the second physician.

fields.description: Name of the third physician or medical practitioner consulted.

fields.description: Address of the third physician or medical practitioner consulted.

fields.name: physician_row_3_dates_consulted
fields.description: Date of consultation with the third physician.

fields.name: hospital_row_1_name
fields.description: Name of the first hospital where the insured was confined.

fields.name: hospital_row_1_address
fields.description: Address of the first hospital where the insured was confined.

fields.name: hospital_row_1_from
fields.description: Start date of the first hospital confinement.

fields.name: hospital_row_1_to
fields.description: End date of the first hospital confinement.

fields.name: hospital_row_1_reason
fields.description: Reason for the first hospital confinement.

fields.name: hospital_row_2_name
fields.description: Name of the second hospital where the insured was confined.

fields.name: hospital_row_2_address
fields.description: Address of the second hospital where the insured was confined.

fields.name: hospital_row_2_from
fields.description: Start date of the second hospital confinement.

fields.name: hospital_row_2_to
fields.description: End date of the second hospital confinement.

fields.name: hospital_row_2_reason
fields.description: Reason for the second hospital confinement.

fields.name: occupation_prior_to_disability
fields.description: Job title held immediately before becoming disabled.

fields.name: date_began_occupation
fields.description: Date when the insured started working in the listed occupation.

fields.name: unable_to_perform_duties
examples: Heavy lifting, operating machinery, and working on scaffolding due to limited mobility and chronic pain.
fields.description: Specific job duties the insured is unable to perform as a result of the disability.

fields.name: prior_work_experience
examples: Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, 12 years of experience in construction site management.
fields.description: Details about prior work experience and educational background.

fields.name: remarks
examples: Ongoing physical therapy and treatment plan in progress.
fields.description: Additional notes or remarks from the insured.

document.document_type: Initial Claimant's Statement for Income Replacement/Waiver of Premium Benefits
document.document_description: This document is an initial claimant's statement used for requesting income replacement or a waiver of premium benefits due to a disabling condition. It includes fields for personal details, employment information, medical history, and occupational duties to assess eligibility for benefits.
